Metadata.title: Solident Association
Metadata.description: Free oral-health care and prevention for underserved communities in northern Morocco.

Home.title: A smile is everyone's right
Home.intro: Since 2024, young dentists from northern Morocco have brought free dental care and oral-health prevention to the communities that need it most.
Home.mission: Promote oral health through awareness, prevention and dental caravans, with fair access to care.
Home.vision: Make oral health a priority in every citizen's life, and take the culture of volunteering further.
Home.actionsMap: All our actions and the map
Home.joinSponsorText: Companies and institutions: link your name to our caravans or co-organise an action with us.
Home.joinVolunteerText: Students, practitioners or volunteers from other fields: there is a place for everyone.
Home.joinDonateText: Every dirham funds care and prevention, and you follow its effect live.
Home.joinContactText: An idea, a question, a joint project? Write to us.

Footer.tagline: Moroccan oral-health association, founded in 2024 in Larache – Ksar El Kébir.

About.title: About us
About.intro: Solident was founded in 2024 by young dental surgeons from northern Morocco, determined to bring oral-health care to those who go without it.
About.story: From Larache and Ksar El Kébir to Ifrane and Tamesna, our caravans bring together dental students, practitioners and volunteers from other fields. Every action combines consultations, treatment, prevention and hygiene kits.
About.charter: Adopted at the General Assembly on 20 September 2026: more flexibility, a shared load, sincere commitments and simple communication.
About.motto: Everyone does what they can. Everyone says clearly what they can do.
About.gov1: The General Assembly meets at least once a year; all active members vote, by majority of those present.
About.gov2: An extraordinary assembly can be called by the president, three board members or a majority of active members.
About.gov3: Each major step is led by a pair of members.
About.joinText: Students, practitioners or volunteers from other professions: there is a place for everyone.
